messages.subject: repair error/crash
parts:
Hi,
I'm trying to run "repair" before I count with featureCounts, but am getting this error: input-files.c:2784: SAM_pairer_get_next_read_BIN: Assertion `l_name < 256' failed

If I run the files through featureCounts directly I don't get the same error, but I'd like to be able to sort beforehand to save some time. 

Thanks!

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: repair error/crash
parts:
The 'repair' function was developed at the time when featureCounts was slow in dealing with location-sorted paired-end reads. But we have made dramatic improvement on the speed of featureCounts in counting location-sorted paired-end reads and featureCounts can now count location-sorted reads at almost the same speed as it does for name-sorted reads. So you do not need to run 'repair' function beforehand anymore.

But we will get this bug fixed in the next release.

Regards,

Wei
